mapper.select: WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM inv_balance WHERE id>#{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}) SELECT coalesce(max(b.id),#{afterId}) AS cursor,count(*) AS rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.on_hand != coalesce((SELECT sum(t.signed_quantity) FROM inv_transaction t WHERE t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.company_id=b.company_id AND t.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND t.location_id=b.location_id AND t.sku_id=b.sku_id AND t.batch_no=b.batch_no),0)) AS mismatches FROM page b
